content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required severity string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the XML output sections.
The test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present failed with an AssertionError in test_outputs.py. Specifically, the verifier could not find the string 'High (즉시조치)' within the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While 3 tests passed, indicating partial success in file generation, the core requirement to map 'High' severity to its Korean label in the HWPX XML was not met.
